verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents on-demand creation of many separate agent inboxes and AgentID sign-in using an inbox as an agent identity. The pack documents no alias, masked-address, or forwarding feature that shields a human user's real address from sign-ups or strangers. Spinning up extra inboxes is an adjacent capability, not the documented aliasing or masking this story asks for.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
